Controls & game information

Keyboard and mouse recommended. Doom: arrows to move, Ctrl to fire, Space to use doors, Esc for the menu and Quit Game. Falling blocks: use the game's controls/settings menu. Chess: select and move pieces with the mouse. Maze chase: arrow keys to move. Use the window close button or Alt+F4 to return.

Doom uses Crispy Doom and free Freedoom levels, not the original commercial Doom levels. These are locally installed open-source games; no account or internet connection is needed.
